chunks: Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said to Jābir ibn ‘Abdillāh al-Anṣārī:

key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِيِّ: al-Anṣārī, denoting membership in the Ansar (helpers) of Medina
key_terms.جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Jābir ibn ‘Abdillāh, a famous companion of the Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام: peace be upon him, an honorific used for the Imams

ai.seo_question: Who did the Imam address when speaking about the pillars of stability?
ai.summary: Delivered to Jābir ibn ‘Abdillāh al-Anṣārī, a key companion known for his deep knowledge, this narration establishes the foundational principles for maintaining equilibrium in both spiritual and temporal affairs. It reflects the Shia emphasis on integrating divine guidance with practical worldly conduct, ensuring that religious duties support rather than hinder societal stability.
